test_intent.behavior: Produce deterministic candidate-run and execution artifacts from reviewed cases.
test_intent.expected_signal: Actual ordered cases, catalog lineage, runner identity, route attempts, and output artifacts remain digest-bound.

test_intent.behavior: Fail closed at every hard evaluation boundary.
test_intent.expected_signal: Quality, privacy, provider, response-size, retry, concurrency, timeout, and spend failures cannot complete a run.

test_intent.behavior: Authorize only current or authenticated non-rolled-back execution evidence.
test_intent.expected_signal: Missing metadata, replay, newer failures, gaps, forks, rollback, restamping, and token reuse remain non-actionable.

red_evidence.check: focused red-first and independent adversarial review
red_evidence.summary: Focused tests first failed on missing evaluator and receipt APIs. Independent review later reproduced empty-fact, spend, replay, route-metadata, response-bound, fixture-substitution, failure-lineage, and token-reuse gaps; each exact scenario was added before the final candidate passed.

green_evidence.summary: The exact candidate passed the full repository gate with 216 tests.
The exact candidate passed all deterministic contract and adversarial tests.
The exact candidate passed all 10 offline golden scenarios.

independent_validation.notes: Independent verification, structured code review, and Vetryn trust review passed on the exact candidate.

test_first_skipped_reason.reason: Focused evaluator and receipt-store tests failed before implementation and every independently reproduced gap received a regression.

anti_fitting_notes: Adversarial tests exercise the public evaluator, transport, CLI, and filesystem receipt store rather than private helpers.
Golden determinism uses independent one-use current-refresh tokens with content-identical reviewed inputs.

Failure tests cover absent and inconsistent route metadata, oversized streaming bodies, same-count case substitution, hard spend boundaries, rollback, omission, forks, later failures, and direct token reuse.
residual_risks: Live OpenRouter execution remains intentionally outside offline CI and requires a separate explicit grant.
Receipt-authenticated recommendation orchestration is the V1-07 consumer boundary; the V1-06 core helper is explicitly artifact-consistency-only.

integrated_validation.scope_summary: The whole repository and offline golden scenarios passed on the exact V1-06 candidate; remote PR gates remain pending.

fresh_checkout.notes: GitHub CI supplies the clean-checkout replay.

release_readiness.notes: V1-06 records a minor Changeset but does not publish packages.
